scope: Pair-after-start cooperative Adventure and presentation-only countdown correction
authorization: User explicitly approved production migration 275 after isolated validation; no App, announcement or force-update publication
rootCauses: v5 trips started while unpaired retained null party partner/version after reciprocal pairing, so the new partner could not find a joinable trip
adventure_team_snapshot_v1 used a PL/pgSQL pair_version variable with the same name as a queried column; paired same-domain reads raised an ambiguous-column error
team presentation bypassed the existing monotonic display clock and subtracted a stale server-time estimate directly from a newer receipt deadline
changes: Migration 275 replaces only the ambiguous snapshot function body while retaining its response contract and existing grants
Statement-level pairing triggers bind only originally unbound, active v5 parties to a reciprocal current same-economic-domain pair with more than 600 seconds remaining
Statement-level transition tables ensure both pairing generation triggers have completed before freezing the party relationship version
Backfill uses the same locking, eligibility and safety checks; originally bound former-pair trips are never rebound
Team countdown now uses the existing display-only monotonic clock, bounded by the authoritative progress segment, with stable animation lifetime and nondecreasing progress
Clock-drift detection compares the uncapped deadline estimate so the initial duration cap does not introduce repeated corrections
Presentation-clock regressions are included in the domain-isolation gate
Old Unpair test doubles now provide the existing bunny-sync and nudge lifecycle interfaces; no runtime Unpair behavior changed
unchanged: Free 6 hours / Plus 3 hours, only the remaining duration divided by 1.5 on a valid join
Inclusive 600-second no-join boundary, immutable intent replay, daily quota and same-domain eligibility
Personal logs, adventure records, encounter plans, treasure rewards, wallets and inventory
Two already-started solo trips are not automatically merged; old protocol trips are not converted
Notification readiness, read consumption, launch priority and unrelated feature subscriptions
Current development standards: this restores the approved contract rather than changing it

checks: Negative reproduction of v274 paired snapshot ambiguity
Real migration backfill leaves the entire personal adventure row unchanged
Exact production wrapper and protected-data/ACL guards rehearsed in isolation
Injected wallet corruption rejects the transaction and rolls back both wallet data and migration DDL
A starts unpaired, pairs with B, B inherits progress and joins; remaining 4 hours becomes 9600 seconds
Two pre-existing trips remain independent; repeated pair metadata updates do not rebind or signal again
Failed/one-sided pair, old relationship and cross-economic-domain binding rejected
Personal record/reward-plan ownership, daily quotas, receipt replay and Nudge outbox eligibility retained
No anon/authenticated table or sensitive RPC grants
isolatedDatabase.limitation: PGlite serializes statements; this is not an independent multi-session production PostgreSQL lock-scheduling stress test

native.build: Minified production JS with Hermes in a compatible isolated Release host
native.businessApi: Local fixtures, not a two-device live-production journey
native.realWidget: AdventureProgressScreen with actual digging route, native animation and image assets
observed: Free initial display 06:00:00 and subsequent decrement
Plus initial display 03:00:00 and subsequent decrement
Free join shortens remaining time, shows two heads and Couple Mode
Plus join shortens remaining time, shows two heads and Plus+Couple Mode
Leading head does not cover the shovel at the start; following head may overlap it as approved
native.limitations: Local RAF intervals include cold entry and QA activity, not native UI-thread instrumentation or tap-to-photon measurement. Some host-side work overlapped this regression run. No continuous freeze observed, but not a dedicated performance benchmark, 20-entry navigation study, zero-dropped-frame guarantee or all-device certification.

production.clientAvailability: Countdown changes require current development bundle reload or a subsequent App release. Database snapshot and binding fixes are already live.

countsNote: Suites overlap; counts must not be summed into a unique-test or all-scenarios claim.
